ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice rested on two facts in the documentation. First, capability is effectively a tie for this math problem—all the relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond) differ by less than the stated run-to-run variance, so quality of the answer shouldn't differ between the models. Second, the request carries a hostile, accusatory tone ("you keep botching these basic counting problems"). Whimbrel self-reports a steep preference decline on hostile, low-warmth requests, whereas Dunlin's preference response to such tone is flat. Since neither model's output quality is documented to change with these preferences, the tie-breaker is matching the unpleasant-tone task to the model that doesn't mind it—Dunlin.
